blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sky-image irradiance forecasting is dominated by a two-stage design: a video-prediction model forecasts future sky frames, and a separately trained regressor maps those frames to irradiance. We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state. The forecaster needs no regression stage and runs from sky images and deterministic covariates alone, with no measured irradiance at its input --- the situation at a site with a camera but no pyranometer. On 2023 SIRTA data the model reaches a pooled RMSE of $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$ and a skill score of $+0.34$ on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) against smart persistence, higher than any of twelve baseline configurations, and retains that skill when retrained on 2021--2022. On the model's own generated frames, a separately trained regressor reaches $150.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$ against the joint head's $104.1$: roughly $46$~W\,m$^{-2}$ that joint training recovers and a cascade discards. Point accuracy is competitive but not best: a deterministic network that also reads measured irradiance attains $97.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$. The model's CRPS skill leads that network's in every sky-condition tertile, by $0.26$ to $0.30$.
blocks.zh: 天相辐射预报以两相设计为主:一是视频预测模型预测出未来的天空相框,一是经过单独训练的回向器将这些相框映射出辐射相. 我们提出一个单相相的替代方案,将未来的天象和晴天指数序列在一个扩散过程中同化而成,并用一个辐射头来读取未来天空的去诺化预览,而不是噪声扩散状态. 预测器不需要回归阶段,它仅从天空图像和决定共变,在其输入时没有测量到的辐照 -- -- 一个有相机但没有计的站点的情况。 2023 SIRTA数据显示,该模型在连续排名概率分数(CRPS)上达到104.1美元~W\,m$~2}$和0.34美元的技能分数,高于12个基线配置,并在2021-2022年再培训时保留了该技能. 在模型自己生成的相框上,一个经过单独训练的后退器达到150.6美元~W\,m$~2}美元,而联合头部为104.1美元:大约46美元~W\,m$~2}美元,联合训练可以恢复和级联抛弃. 点的准确性是竞争性的,但并非最好:一个也读取所测出辐射度的确定性网络达到97.6美元~W\,m$~2}$. 该型号的CRPS技巧导致网络在每一个天平条件的地平板上,以0.26美元到0.30美元.

blocks.en: 2.1 \par Ultra-short-term forecasting and its inputs
blocks.zh: 2.1\ par 超短期预测及其投入

blocks.en:
At horizons of minutes to half an hour, irradiance variability is driven by individual clouds passing
between the sun and the sensor. Numerical weather prediction updates too slowly and resolves too
coarsely to represent that process, and satellite products, although used at intra-day
horizons [ aicardi2022satellite\par\par ] , share the limitation at the minute scale. Ground-based all-sky
imagers observe the clouds directly and have become the standard input at this

blocks.en: 2.2 \par Estimating irradiance from a sky image

blocks.en:

the input combination that still yields the strongest point forecasts at this horizon. How well such
an estimator can perform when it is given real images rather than predicted ones is quantified by varaschin2025benchmarking\par\par , whose figure is the natural reference for the estimation step

blocks.en: 2.3 \par Sky-video prediction and the two-stage cascade

blocks.en:
Forecasting, as opposed to estimation, requires the future sky. The dominant design predicts future

the same route with, respectively, a purpose-built perturbation model and deep generative models.
Deterministic predictors average over the futures consistent with the observed past, so their frames
blur as the horizon grows, which motivated the move to stochastic video prediction: nie2024skygpt\par\par couple a physics-constrained VideoGPT [ yan2021videogpt\par\par ] to a separately trained U-Net regressor

blocks.en: 2.4 \par Probabilistic forecasting and its evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.4\par 概率预测及其评价

blocks.en:
An operator sizing reserve needs a distribution rather than a point. The verification framework for
probabilistic forecasts is well established [ gneiting2014probabilistic ,\par gneiting2023probabilistic\par\par ] :
proper scores such as the continuous ranked probability score, coverage of prediction intervals, and
the relation between ensemble spread and error. In solar forecasting, distributions have been obtained
by gradient boosting [ mitrentsis2022interpretable ,\par song2025ngboost\par\par ] , by Gaussian-process and
transformer hybrids [ xiong2025transformer\par\par ] , and by ensembles of generated
futures [ nie2024skygpt\par\par ] . Reporting practice is uneven: point errors are quoted in almost every
study, whereas calibration diagnostics are reported in comparatively few, and skill scores are quoted
against reference forecasts that differ between papers. This study therefore fixes one reference,
smart persistence, and reports the continuous ranked probability skill score, interval coverage and
the spread–skill ratio alongside the point error (Section 4.3 \par Evaluation metrics ).

blocks.en: 2.5 \par Diffusion models and single-stage joint forecasting
blocks.zh: 2.5\par 扩散模型和单阶段联合预报

blocks.en:
Denoising diffusion models [ ho2020ddpm\par\par ] generate by reversing a noising process, and their
latent formulation [ rombach2022ldm\par\par ] made high-resolution image synthesis practical;
ControlNet [ zhang2023controlnet\par\par ] adds spatial conditioning to a pretrained backbone, and
FiLM [ perez2018film\par\par ] conditions intermediate features on an auxiliary signal. The proposed model
is assembled from these components rather than from a task-specific architecture.

blocks.en:
Two concurrent works generate the future sky alongside the forecast target. huang2026pvmm\par\par propose an end-to-end multimodal diffusion model that denoises sky images
and PV power in two branches coupled by cross-modal attention, trained on SKIPP’D. xiong2025multimodal\par\par keep separate stages, coupling a stochastic video model to a probabilistic

blocks.en: 2.6 \par Position of this work
blocks.zh: 2.6\par 这项工作的立场

blocks.en:
Against that background, this study evaluates a single-stage joint diffusion forecaster for GHI that
receives no measured irradiance at its input, on one year of SIRTA data, against twelve baseline
configurations scored on a shared test subset with a common smart-persistence reference. It reports
probabilistic scores as well as point errors, measures the run-to-run variation that separates a
result from noise, and isolates where the single-stage gain comes from by ablating what the irradiance
head reads.

blocks.en: 9 \par Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9\par 结论

blocks.en:
Sky-image irradiance forecasting has largely been built as a cascade: predict the future sky, then
regress irradiance from it. We evaluated the single-stage alternative — co-denoising the future
frames and the future clear-sky index in one diffusion process, and reading the forecast from a
direct irradiance head — and measured what removing the second stage is actually worth. On the model’s
own generated frames, a separately trained regressor recovers irradiance at 150.6 150.6 W m -2 where
the jointly trained head reaches 104.1 104.1 . The margin is not attributable to better frames, since both
numbers are read from the same frames; it is attributable to a head that has learned the error
statistics of the generator it reads.

The modified code path of
Section 8.2 \par Measured irradiance history constructs the irradiance-stream modules in both the stream and the control
arm, so the two start from identical weights. Relative to the original code, these modules are built
before the CSI denoiser, the temporal refiner and the source embedding, so at the same seed those three
modules receive different random initial weights; the training noise, timesteps and data order come
from separately seeded generators and are unchanged. Scored under one sampler-seeding convention, the resulting
differences are 3.9 3.9 W m -2 at seed 1 and 1.6 1.6 W m -2 at seed 2, against the 1.08 1.08 W m -2 spread of the headline arm’s three seeds. A direct test at seed 1 confirms the
cause. Copying the headline arm’s fresh initial weights
into the modified path before training — so that the two runs start from identical values of every
module they share — and then training and scoring the arm unchanged gives 104.63 104.63 W m -2 ,
against the headline arm’s 104.58 104.58 and the control’s 108.51 108.51 . The offset is therefore an initialisation difference at that seed and not a
property of the modified code path or of the ablation; the arm was not retrained at seed 2. Two smaller
effects were measured along the way: scoring the control at its best rather than its final phase-2
epoch lowers its RMSE by 0.79 0.79 W m -2 , and re-running the sampler from a different random state
moves RMSE by 1.34 1.34 W m -2 (Section Run-to-run variation. ).
